verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents building audiences on warehouse sources and syncing or activating them to downstream tools, backed by reverse ETL to 200+ SaaS destinations. Nothing in the evidence shows that sync is continuous or that members enter and exit in near-real-time, and the warehouse-based framing suggests scheduled batch syncs. Missing for 10: evidence of continuous or streaming audience sync, near-real-time membership entry/exit handling, named ad-platform and engagement-tool audience destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
